preprocessing.spatial: IMPROVE B2 label-free body square crop, threshold.05, LCC8,5% each-side margin,zero padding; no physical resampling
preprocessing.features: final block LayerNorm tokens, CLS removed, patch L2, uncentered

segmentation.fit: all slices, all patches, no labels
segmentation.mapping: other19 labels only; K8 strict-majority and exhaustive optimal subset; K2 Hungarian maximizing confusion count
segmentation.outside_crop: forced background not eligible for mapping
segmentation.aggregation: pool pixels per patient; average seeds per patient, then equal-patient mean/sample SD/min/max

selectivity.sampling: SELECTIVITY/PAIRS batch order, seeds, actual loss.forward coordinates;7 passes,11x11 coordinates;fixed2048 of14641 pair positions
selectivity.centering: actual project helper pointwise restored-global-mean, zero_clamp=True,stabalize=False
selectivity.thresholds: global affinity quantiles; labels not read until scores/cuts saved
selectivity.labels: common28x28 majority cells of body-cropped nearest448 mask, ties background; actual nearest sampler coordinates
selectivity.reference: BiomedCLIP cached B2_44828-grid; original SELECTIVITY14-grid full-frame reference listed separately as historical

figures.pca: fit label-free on these8 feature grids jointly; deterministic full SVD; each RGB component scales using joint1st/99th percentiles; no scoring/selection

decision: justified only if an available declared arm reaches K8 224 LOPO liver IoU >=62.87% and same-image liver-anchor AUC >=.90; report mapping rule triggering gate explicitly; no head training
